mapper.select: SELECT pm.material_id, mr.requirement_id, mr.requirement_name, mr.is_required AS required_flag, mr.description, COALESCE(pm.submit_status, 'pending') AS submit_status, pm.file_id, fa.file_name, pm.version_no, pm.remark, pm.submitted_at FROM competition_project cp JOIN material_requirement mr ON mr.notice_id = cp.notice_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pm_inner.* FROM project_material pm_inner JOIN ( SELECT project_id, requirement_id, MAX(version_no) AS max_version_no FROM project_material WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY project_id, requirement_id ) latest_pm ON latest_pm.project_id = pm_inner.project_id AND latest_pm.requirement_id = pm_inner.requirement_id AND latest_pm.max_version_no = pm_inner.version_no WHERE pm_inner.is_deleted = 0 ) pm ON pm.project_id = cp.project_id AND pm.requirement_id = mr.requirement_id LEFT JOIN file_asset fa ON fa.file_id = pm.file_id AND fa.is_deleted = 0 WHERE cp.project_id = #{projectId} AND cp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY mr.sort_no ASC, mr.requirement_id ASC
